blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla said investigators have found indications linking the son of Meghan Markle’s estranged father to alleged child sexual abuse, although he remains a person of interest in the case. “There are signs that point to the son being involved in the crime as well, but only as a person of interest so far,” Remulla said. “Well, we are determining if the son is involved kasi may witness kami na underage girls are being brought to his house, and we are following it up,” Remulla added.
